name: Slap Battles: Average FanMade [DISCONTINUED!
desc:
Sorry guys, i dont have more motivitation for this game anymore, i am working on a new game called Shovel Battles, please be patient while its being made. If the new game isnt up, i may update this game.

New game link is here: https://www.roblox.com/games/10531659515/Shovel-Battles-EARLY-TESTING


An game where you slap people to get stronger gloves. Point of the game, mostly this is old but ig you can play it. Dont complain if theres someone with the cyan touch glove. Some gloves are passive (when on hit), and some gloves are Press E to Use. (mobile players have a button) Some gloves even are obtained by gamepasses or badges.

Credits to people who even made some thumbnails or game icons!

this is a solo project
